hooks.command: jq -c 'select((.tool_input.command // "") | test("^git commit")) | {hookSpecificOutput: {hookEventName: "PostToolUse", additionalContext: "A git commit just happened. Inspect it with git log -1 + git show HEAD, then: (1) decide if it shipped a tracked backlog item — if yes, invoke /ship; if bug fix / refactor / partial step, do nothing. (2) COACHING DOCTRINE BACKSTOP — if the commit touched CoachingPrinciples.md, generationConfig.ts, planSignatures.ts, sessionFormat.ts, session-catalogue.md, zone-rules.md or coaching-rules.md, verify a Coaching Board review ruled on it AND that all three artifacts landed together (principle section, GENERATION_CONFIG constant, validatePlan() invariant + plan-invariants.md row). If an artifact is missing, say so now — see ADR-017."}}'
